youtube.title: Starting From $0? Do These 7 Money Steps in This Order #Shorts
youtube.description:
Starting from $0? These 7 money steps work best in this exact order:
1. Find your number
2. Starter emergency fund
3. Kill credit card debt (around 21% interest)
4. Grab your full 401(k) match
5. Open a Roth IRA
6. Buy a low-cost index fund
7. Automate it and leave it alone

Full step-by-step guide on the channel: "If I Had to Start Investing From $0 in 2026".

📌 Educational content only, not financial advice.
